title: Mem0
oneLiner: Open-source memory layer for AI agents and assistants that need personalized recall.
summary: Mem0 is an open-source memory layer for AI applications, designed to store, retrieve, and update user or agent memories across conversations and workflows.
whyItMatters: Mem0 matters because personalization and continuity are hard to build from scratch. A dedicated memory layer gives agents a place to store durable user facts, preferences, and task history.
bestFor: Builders adding long-term memory to agents or chat apps
Teams that need self-hosted memory infrastructure
Developers comparing memory layers before building custom recall
notFor: Users who want a fully managed consumer product with no setup work
Teams that cannot review the linked source, license, and operational requirements before adoption

seoArticle.intro: Mem0 is an open-source memory layer for AI applications, designed to store, retrieve, and update user or agent memories across conversations and workflows.
seoArticle.whatItIs: Mem0 is an open memory-system resource to evaluate by what it stores, how recall works, how memory is scoped, and whether users or teams can inspect, correct, export, or delete durable context.
seoArticle.whyItMatters: Mem0 matters because personalization and continuity are hard to build from scratch. A dedicated memory layer gives agents a place to store durable user facts, preferences, and task history.
seoArticle.howItWorks: Test Mem0 with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.
